<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, touching **8** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-extension-item.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-extension-item.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **64** of **227** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **163** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **163**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **10** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7d0b47ca19c8c41563964b3889ae81e8e015788e` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `ffe8f7548a034b1530bf3048552685a1f56fa546` — the merge of head `2eeb629ef97cf56bf8d682668dadb0eb2138b1e6` into base `7d0b47ca19c8c41563964b3889ae81e8e015788e`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin ffe8f7548a034b1530bf3048552685a1f56fa546 && git checkout ffe8f7548a034b1530bf3048552685a1f56fa546
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 7d0b47ca19c8c41563964b3889ae81e8e015788e 2eeb629ef97cf56bf8d682668dadb0eb2138b1e6 && git checkout -B drift-repro 7d0b47ca19c8c41563964b3889ae81e8e015788e && git merge --no-ff 2eeb629ef97cf56bf8d682668dadb0eb2138b1e6

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7d0b47ca19c8c41563964b3889ae81e8e015788e
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 7d0b47ca19c8c41563964b3889ae81e8e015788e` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `f7fcd1260f021cd1a3d49dcfca12fbbd8357ce38`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #31399 body and all 3 comments (triage, claim, os-dev-report; no earlier record), PR #31480 body and file list (5 files), the net diff against `main` (merge-base `f67f3b35`), and the 48 check-runs on the head: 35 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending. The commit-status API holds no statuses. Code outside the diff was read, not reviewed.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept sets: none move. Right.** No `packages/spec/src` file is in the diff, so `SeedSchema` is unchanged. No save, validate or publish door is touched. `listSlotNameOf`, the registry hydration loop and `packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts` are unchanged.
- **`GET /api/v1/meta/:type` / `getMetaItems` (served list): a stored body that states no `name` of its own is now listed, slotted by its row's `name` column, and served with that `name`. Right, and no published shape moves.**
  - `GetMetaItemsResponseSchema.items` is `z.array(z.unknown())` (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts:367-369`). The client SDK's `meta.getItems` returns that type (`packages/client/src/index.ts:1994`). The route row says "Returns all items of the specified metadata type" (`plugin-rest-api.zod.ts`, `/:type`). None of them states what an item holds, so adding `name` changes no published type. The list's own companions (`registrations`, `disabledActions`) are documented as "keyed by the item's `name`", so the list already assumes each item carries a `name`.
  - The by-name read serves the seed body as stored, with no `name`, and carries the name only on the envelope (`protocol-meta-item-reads.ts:378-381` builds `item` from `storedRowDocument`, and the return at `:738-740` puts `name: request.name` beside it). So list and get differ on the item body. **This divergence is acceptable.** A list has no per-item envelope, and a seed body has nothing else unique to identify it by (`object` repeats: `x_seed`, `x_seed_2`). Putting the name anywhere other than on the item would need a new key in the spec, which belongs to the spec lane and is outside this card's surface. The cost is that a listed seed does not PUT back as served: strict `SeedSchema` refuses `name`. That goes against the invariant written in `listSlotNameOf`'s docblock (see N1).
  - **Hidden diagnostics:**
    - A body that states its own name, valid or not, is not marked, and is decorated exactly as on `main`.
    - A non-seed body with no name is now listed. Its `_diagnostics` are computed without the served `name`, so a schema that requires `name` still reports it missing, which is the same verdict the by-name read gives.
    - One case regresses: an own `name: null` is now dropped from every merge (S1).
- **`getMetaItemsForExecution` / `getMetaItemsPerPackage`: the same merge, so the same items, now carrying `name` and the in-process `SERVED_ROW_NAME` symbol mark.** The mark is a symbol key, so JSON drops it. The execution face is never served to a caller. No in-repo execution or per-package consumer lists `seed`: package export iterates `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR`, which has no `seed` entry. This is acceptable, but the docblock for this face ("the stored bodies") no longer fully holds (N1).
- **Package-shipped seed with the same name: one slot, and the stored row wins. Right, and consistent with the other types.** The record enters the same `slotOf(body, name)` bucket as the registry item, and `servedStoredRow` picks the stored row of the same package, as it does for every type. Another package's seed keeps its own slot (pin §2). In practice the registry holds no shipped seed item (`plugin.ts:211-219`), so this case is synthetic today.
- **Internal surface:** `SERVED_ROW_NAME` and `withoutServedRowName` are exported from `protocol-overlay-merge.ts`, and `StoredRowPlace.name?` is added. None of them is reachable from `src/index.ts`, and the package's `exports` map has only `.`. Not public.
- **Reach beyond seed:** the row-name fallback applies to any stored body without its own `name`, not only `seed` (N2).

### ② Semver level

- **`Clause-②: no` is right.** The diff touches no contract path (`packages/spec/src/**`). No accept set moves, and the one published response schema involved (`items: unknown[]`) is unchanged. The read now serves rows it already stored and already served by name.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none` is right.** Nothing a metadata author can write changes. `patch` on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` is the level `none` takes. The declaration lines match the claim, the PR body and the changeset, and `Check Changeset` is green.
- **The changeset text is true of the code, with one exception.** "A body that states its own name keeps it" is false for an own `name: null`, which is now dropped (S1). It becomes true once S1 lands. The rest checks out against the code: the environment list, the package-scoped list and the draft preview (`protocol-meta-list-reads.ts:252-271`, `:573-578`), one slot shared with the shipped seed, the stored body not written, and `SeedSchema` unchanged.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flag: listed seeds served with `name`, and `decorateListedItem` judging the marked body as stored.**
  - Accepted. Without the judgment change, every listed seed reads `valid: false` for a key the server itself added. With it, the list's verdict equals the by-name read's, and pin §1 plus ablation 2 show this.
  - Redaction still runs on the copy that is served (`decorateMetadataItem(type, stored)`). The symbol mark never reaches the wire, because the served copy is rebuilt from `stored`, which has no mark.
  - The divergence from the by-name body is judged in ①. The documentation it owes is N1.
- **Dev deviation: `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` (+5), outside the claimed surface.** Accepted. `check:engine-double-contract` reconciles its ledger in both directions, and the new pin's `findOne` double calls `assertEngineFindOnePredicate`, so the ledger must record it. The entry is mechanical `--write` output, sorted in place, and `Lint · CI, release & engine gates` is green.
- **Dev deviations: the worktree name (`objectstack-issue-31317` instead of `objectstack-issue-31399`), and `pr_create` dispatched twice (the second failed 422 and wrote nothing).** These are process facts with no effect on the diff. Noted, nothing owed.
- **Card constraints.**
  - No `SeedSchema` change: held.
  - #30808's install-local by-name receipt read (`readUnmanagedCopySeedReceipt` and `unmanagedCopySeedNames` in `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`): untouched, and its file is not in the diff.
  - Door measured first: done, with the door and the method agreeing, so the card was not narrowed.
  - Blame named: ee9312f7ae, then #1569, #3231 and #28811/#28574.
  - Red-then-green pin and ablations: two ablations, both restored.
- **`open_questions`:** none.
- **Out-of-scope finding (the #30808 receipt could go back to a list read):** acknowledged, with no card owed. The card said to leave it alone. The served list carries no mark, so if that read ever moved to the list, `seedDatasetOfReceiptItem`'s projection would have to keep dropping `name`.
- **Author:** `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no login note is needed.

**Findings**

- **S1 (should-fix): `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-overlay-merge.ts:399`.**
  - `const bodyName = ownName ?? rowName;` turns a body that states `name: null` into a skip. `listSlotNameOf` answers `null` for it, and since `rowName` is only computed when `ownName === undefined`, `null ?? undefined` gives `undefined`, and `continue` drops the record.
  - On `main`, the same record was listed (under the `"null"` slot, with `_diagnostics` flagging the name). Now it vanishes silently from every `mergePackageAwareOverlay` caller. That includes `protocol-stored-collection-fold.ts:137` and the MetadataService merge (`protocol-meta-list-reads.ts:676`), which the PR body calls unchanged.
  - The base-items loop at `:380` still keeps `null` (`itemName !== undefined`), so the two loops now disagree.
  - Fix: `const bodyName = ownName !== undefined ? ownName : rowName;`. Add a §4 control row to `protocol.seed-list-row-name.test.ts` (from `:190`): a stored dashboard body with `name: null` lists one item, and its `_diagnostics.valid` is `false`, as on `main`.
  - This is owed a delta review on the fixing head.
- **N1 (nit, prose): `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-extension-item.ts:78-85`.**
  - `listSlotNameOf`'s docblock states the read invariant "The body is not given a `name`: a read serves it as it is stored, so what a GET answers PUTs back through the strict schema." The list now gives a nameless body its row's `name`, so a listed seed PUT back as served is refused by strict `SeedSchema` (`Unrecognized key(s) on this seed: name`). The by-name read's body still round-trips.
  - The `getMetaItemsForExecution` docblock (`protocol.ts:3352-3355`) likewise says "the stored bodies", but the execution face now also carries the served `name` and the symbol mark.
  - Fix: state the exception once, in the `SERVED_ROW_NAME` docblock (`protocol-overlay-merge.ts:59-66`), with a pointer from `listSlotNameOf`. It should say that the list and the execution face carry the row's `name` on a body that states none, that the by-name read does not, and that a writer reads by name or drops `name` before a save.
- **N2 (nit, prose): PR body, the 维护者速读 risk line, "今天只有 `seed`".**
  - This is not true of the code. The fallback applies to any stored body without its own `name`. That includes `translation` rows saved while `TranslationItemSchema` still stripped the undeclared `name` (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts:2638-2655`), and any malformed nameless row of any type. These now list under their row's name, with `_diagnostics` matching the by-name read.
  - Fix: reword that line, and optionally the changeset's second paragraph, to say "a stored body that states no name (seeds; legacy translation rows; malformed rows)".

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-2n2fmy`
Reviewed-by: `session_01FEkQ5pXkgNXVpCn2GZDjyy`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `2eeb629ef97cf56bf8d682668dadb0eb2138b1e6`
Local-runs: none

This is the delta review of 6720799308 (PASS on `f7fcd126`). It judges only `git diff f7fcd126..2eeb629e`, the PR body as it now stands and the changeset.

The delta is one commit (parent `f7fcd126`) touching 4 files, +30 −2: `protocol-overlay-merge.ts`, `protocol-object-extension-item.ts`, `protocol.ts` and the pin `protocol.seed-list-row-name.test.ts`. There is no merge of main and no changeset edit.

Check-runs on the head: 49 in total. 12 succeeded, 15 were skipped, 0 failed and 22 are still in progress. The 22 in progress are NOT MEASURED: Build Core, Test Core 1/8 to 8/8, the four Type Check lanes, the seven Lint lanes (ESLint, docs and code guards, repo and tooling gates, CI/release/engine gates, and the three scoped lanes), one Check Changeset run, and Live E2E UI. A second Check Changeset run, Dogfood Regression Gate, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Governed Surface Queue Guard and the PR-body guards are green. The commit-status API holds no statuses. Code outside the delta was read, not reviewed.

### ① Derived judgments

- **S1 (round 1): resolved.**
  - `protocol-overlay-merge.ts:409` now reads `const bodyName = ownName !== undefined ? ownName : rowName;`. An own `name: null` gives `bodyName === null`, which reaches `slotOf(body, null)` as on `main`, so the record is listed again.
  - `rowName` is only computed when `ownName === undefined`, so a null-named body is neither given the row's name nor marked `SERVED_ROW_NAME`. It is decorated exactly as on `main`, and `_diagnostics` flags it.
  - The base-items loop (`itemName !== undefined`) and the records loop now agree on `null`.
- **The other callers of the merge behave as on `main` for named and null-named bodies. Right.**
  - On `main` the records loop was `bodyName = listSlotNameOf(type, body); if (bodyName === undefined) continue;`.
  - At the head, whenever `listSlotNameOf` answers anything other than `undefined` (a string, or `null`), `rowName` is `undefined`, `body` is `data` unchanged, and `bodyName` is the same value. The path is identical to `main`.
  - When it answers `undefined`, `rowName` needs `stored?.name`. Neither `protocol-stored-collection-fold.ts:137` nor the MetadataService merge (`protocol-meta-list-reads.ts:656`) passes `stored`, so both still `continue`, as on `main`.
  - The only callers that do pass `stored` are the environment and package list (`:256`) and the draft preview (`:568`). They take the new path only for absent names, which round 1 already judged.
- **The new control row pins the fix. Right.**
  - The row is a stored dashboard row named `row_spelling` with body `{ name: null, label: 'Nameless' }`. It asserts `items` has length 1, `items[0].name` is `null`, and `_diagnostics.valid` is `false`.
  - This is the row round 1 asked for. Its assertion on `name` also proves the row's name was not substituted.
  - The PR body reports it red on `f7fcd126`, green on main's sources and green on the head, and an ablation back to `??` turns it red. The CI test shards that would confirm this are NOT MEASURED (in progress).
  - The pin's header §4 is updated to match.
- **N1 (round 1): resolved, as structured.**
  - The `SERVED_ROW_NAME` docblock now states the PUT-back exception once.
  - `listSlotNameOf`'s docblock (`protocol-object-extension-item.ts:85-86`) and `getMetaItemsForExecution`'s (`protocol.ts:3375-3377`) point to it.
  - The execution-face pointer is accurate: that face does hand back the row's `name` on a body that states none.
  - The wording of the new paragraph overreaches (N3).
- **Published shapes: none move in the delta.** No `packages/spec/src` path is touched. `SERVED_ROW_NAME` stays an internal export, unreachable from `src/index.ts`. The delta's only behaviour change returns a `main` behaviour.

### ② Semver level

- **`Clause-②: no` still holds.** The delta touches no contract path and no accept set. It restores `main`'s listing of null-named bodies.
- **The changeset is unchanged (`'@objectstack/metadata-protocol': patch`, `Metadata-protocol: none`) and is now true throughout.** "A body that states its own name keeps it" was false at `f7fcd126` for an own `name: null` and is true at the head. Its other sentences were checked in round 1 and the delta does not touch them.
- The PR body still carries `Clause-②: no (...)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, matching the changeset.
- Check Changeset has one run green and one run in progress. The in-progress run is NOT MEASURED.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **N2 (round 1): resolved.** The 维护者速读 risk line no longer says "今天只有 `seed`". It names `seed`, legacy translation rows saved before the schema declared `name`, and malformed nameless rows. It says they were missing from the list before and are now listed by row name, with diagnostics judged on the stored body. It also states that an own `name` (`name: null` included) still lists under itself.
- **The rewritten PR body is otherwise true of the code:**
  - The What-changes bullet says only an absent `name` falls to the row's, and names the docblock exception and its two pointers.
  - The Tests section has 11 rows, including the null control.
  - The two-minute check says "11 条全绿,其中 7 条在 main 上是红的". That is consistent: the original 7 rows are red on `main` and the 3 old controls plus the null control are green there.
  - Verification adds the S1 red/green and ablation legs and `79 derived, 79 run` dispatch-gates at `2eeb629e`. This is the dev's local account. The CI lanes for it are NOT MEASURED.
- **`open_questions`:** none. No new dev flag.

**Findings**

- **N3 (nit, prose): the new `SERVED_ROW_NAME` paragraph (`protocol-overlay-merge.ts:67-72`) and the PR body's matching risk-line sentence ("原样 PUT 回严格 schema 会被拒") overstate the PUT-back refusal.**
  - The paragraph says any body served with its row's name "carries a `name` the strict schema refuses". Its own example, "a legacy row saved before its schema declared one", is the case where the schema now declares `name`: `TranslationItemSchema` has `name: z.string().optional()` (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`), so such a listed translation PUTs back with the served name and is accepted.
  - Likewise, a malformed nameless row of a type that declares `name` accepts it. The refusal is real only where the type's schema declares no `name`, which today means `seed` (strict `SeedSchema`).
  - This has no effect on correctness or the contract.
  - Optional fix: "a `seed` listed with its row's `name` is refused if PUT back verbatim (strict `SeedSchema` declares none); a type whose schema declares `name` accepts it".
- No must-fix and no should-fix in the delta.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-2n2fmy`
Reviewed-by: `session_01FEkQ5pXkgNXVpCn2GZDjyy`

**VERDICT: PASS**

**席位意见：ACCEPT · Head-sha `2eeb629ef97cf56bf8d682668dadb0eb2138b1e6` · 2026-11-08T12:22Z**。正文「维护者速读」与席位读到的 diff 一致。本 PR 不在 governed 面上，由席位落地，维护者不需要操作。

## 席位核对

- **形态：** draft，目标 `main`，`Fixes #31399`。`Clause-②: no` 和 `Metadata-protocol: none` 都在行首，changeset 也写了。没有改 `packages/spec/src`：`SeedSchema` 不变，#30808 安装门按名读取回执的代码也没动（卡上的两条约束都守住了）。
- **契约复审（TIER_DEFAULT）：**
  - 席位应 dev 的提议做了复审，因为列表里的 seed 项会多出一个 `name`。
  - r1 6720799308 PASS，S1：`??` 会把 `name: null` 的项丢掉。
  - delta 6721228124 PASS（本 head）：S1、N1、N2 已关闭。剩一条 nit N3，接受不修：`SERVED_ROW_NAME` 的说明和速读里那句 "PUT 回会被拒" 只对 `seed` 成立，legacy translation 行可以 PUT 回。
  - 发布面不变：`GetMetaItemsResponseSchema.items` 是 `unknown[]`，客户端的 `getItems` 返回同一类型。
- **前提实测：** dev 先在真实 showcase 启动上测了门：3 条已发布的 seed 行，`GET /api/v1/meta/seed` 答 `[]`，按名读每条都有。所以卡没有缩小范围。修复后同一探针列出 3 条，带名字，且有效。
- **门禁（check-runs @ `2eeb629e`）：** 37 success，15 skipped，0 失败，0 运行中。dev 本地 `dispatch-gates --ran` 79/79，退出码 0；metadata-protocol 共 22588 个测试全部通过。
- **changeset：** `31399-seed-list-row-name.md`，给 `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 记一个 patch，内容与 diff 相符。
- **接受的偏差：** `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` 多了 5 行，是新测试替身的 `--write` 产物。`decorateListedItem` 改成按存储原样判读 diagnostics。worktree 名沿用了 `objectstack-issue-31317`。
- **范围外去向：** #30808 那边的回执可以改回按列表读取，正文已说明，这里不改。
- **落地条款：** `check-governed-merges --pr 31480`：0 个 governed，+331/−12，共 343 行，走普通队列。席位把它转为 ready 并开启 auto-merge，合并后关闭 #31399。
